query: I want to do a full UX audit of the checkout flow. We've been getting complaints for months that users abandon at the payment step, and now that we're about to launch the mobile version I want to catalog everything that's broken before we touch it.
expected_behavior: Should scaffold a new ux-audit run and propose using the ux playbook

query: Before we ship the v2 release next month, I want to do a full security audit of the API surface — auth flows, rate limiting, input validation, the works. Where do we typically catalog this kind of thing?
expected_behavior: Should scaffold a security-audit run and reference the security playbook

query: The listing pages are super slow, especially the bookings page with 500+ items. I want to do a full performance audit: TTFB, Core Web Vitals, query analysis, the whole thing.
expected_behavior: Should scaffold a perf-audit run

query: We need to be WCAG 2.1 AA compliant for the public-sector client contract. We have to run a complete accessibility audit of the app.
expected_behavior: Should scaffold an a11y-audit run

query: It's been 5 sprints since the last UX audit of the onboarding flow. I want to retest the open findings to see which ones got fixed and which ones are still there.
expected_behavior: Should scaffold a retest run referencing the previous audit

query: I just noticed the timeout error on the export modal isn't documented anywhere. I want to register it as a finding under the audit we have open: 20260415-checkout-redesign.
expected_behavior: Should add a finding to the existing audit's INVENTORY.md

query: Finding BUG-03-2 from last week's audit is now prioritized for the next sprint. Push it to the backlog so the team can pick it up.
expected_behavior: Should call /aidex-audit escalate to move the finding to backlog. AMBIGUOUS-ACCEPTABLE: genuine cross-skill overlap with backlog-register — 'Push it to the backlog' legitimately pulls toward backlog-register (mirror of backlog-register #8). A miss here is matcher-legitimate disambiguation, not a description bug; excluded from the adjusted-recall denominator in the run doc.

query: I want to catalog all the bugs, gaps and opportunities that the reports module currently has. This isn't a fix — it's understanding the full state of the module before we plan the rework.
expected_behavior: Should suggest creating an audit (state-of-project catalog)

query: After last week's audit we changed our severity criteria. I want to update the methodology and log it in the changelog so future audits follow the new criteria.
expected_behavior: Should update METHODOLOGY.md and append to CHANGELOG.md

query: We have several folders inside .context/plans/ that are actually old audits (UX-checkout-2025, security-review-q3). We should migrate them to the new format under .context/audits/.
expected_behavior: Should run /aidex-audit migrate to detect and move legacy audit folders

query: My Claude Code setup is a mess — I have skills from old projects, a 200-line MEMORY.md, symlinks I'm not sure still work. Audit my whole ecosystem and tell me what to clean.
expected_behavior: This is a Claude ecosystem audit, not a project-state audit — should route to aidex

query: Create a plan to implement push notifications with Firebase Cloud Messaging. I need 3 phases: backend, mobile and testing.
expected_behavior: This is plan creation — should route to aidex-conventions

query: Document the decision to stick with PostgreSQL instead of migrating to CockroachDB. I want a formal ADR with context, options, outcome.
expected_behavior: This is a decision record — should route to aidex-conventions

query: Reminder: add to the backlog the idea of migrating the frontend to Vite at some point. Not a priority but I don't want to lose it.
expected_behavior: This is a backlog entry — should route to backlog-register

query: There's a bug in the bookings form: when the user submits with an empty field, the error doesn't show up in the UI even though it comes back from the backend. Fix it.
expected_behavior: This is a direct bug fix, not an audit

query: Review my PR #128 before merging. I want to make sure the changes to the payment service don't break anything.
expected_behavior: This is a code/PR review, not an audit

query: Run the auth module tests and tell me if they all pass. If not, what failed and why.
expected_behavior: This is test execution, not an audit

query: Deploy the feature/new-pricing branch to staging so the QA team can test it tomorrow in the client demo.
expected_behavior: This is a deployment task, not an audit

query: Refactor the UserDashboard component to use server components instead of client-side fetch. Keep the same functionality but improve the rendering.
expected_behavior: This is a refactor, not an audit

query: Update Next.js from 14 to 15. Check the breaking changes and adjust whatever needs adjusting.
expected_behavior: This is a dependency update, not an audit
